## Description

A flattened hypotrich ciliate (~90 µm) that "walks" on the glass with its cirri (bundles of fused
cilia), with sudden stops. It grazes bacteria and small algae. Broad oval, somewhat truncated in
front.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `moss` (weight 0.5), `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15), `sea_ice` (weight 2); 4 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A [walker](../../mechanics/locomotion.md) grazing surfaces and the biofilm. Prey of *Litonotus* and *Lembadion*.
